fields.label: Room code (Mã phòng)
fields.helpText: FOREIGN KEY. Must repeat the parent room record's Room code exactly.

validation.patternMessage: Must match an existing room code, e.g. TB01-0203.

fields.label: Reading month (Tháng chốt chỉ số)
fields.helpText: Use the first day of the billing month, e.g. 2026-07-01.

fields.label: Period YYYYMM (Kỳ, dạng YYYYMM)
fields.helpText: Sortable numeric month, e.g. 202607. Required because the relation reader orders children by when the row was TYPED, not by the month it belongs to.

fields.label: Electricity previous reading (Chỉ số điện cũ)
Electricity current reading (Chỉ số điện mới)
Electricity unit price, VND/kWh (Đơn giá điện, VNĐ/kWh)
Water previous reading (Chỉ số nước cũ)
Water current reading (Chỉ số nước mới)
Water unit price, VND/m3 (Đơn giá nước, VNĐ/m³)
Other charges, VND (Chi phí khác, VNĐ)
Total amount, VND (Tổng tiền, VNĐ)
fields.helpText: Denormalised total so the month can be filtered and summed without recomputing.

fields.label: Demo marker (Dấu dữ liệu demo)
fields.helpText: Seed marker. All rows carrying DEMO-RENTAL-2026 are fictional demo data and can be bulk-deleted.
